prompt: Implement `validate_username(name)` in accounts.py. Return the username lowercased if valid, else raise ValueError with a helpful message. Valid usernames are 3 to 20 characters of ASCII letters, digits, underscores or single hyphens; they must start with a letter, can't end with a hyphen or underscore, and can't contain two separators in a row. Reserved names "admin", "root" and "support" are rejected regardless of case.
